messages.ko: 밴쿠버를 마지막으로 벌써 북미투어공연이 끝이 나네 오기전에 24명에서 어떻게 투어를 할 수 있으려나 많이 걱정했는데 우려했던것보다 수월하게 잘 끝낸것같아서 다행이다 아프거나 다친 멤버들도 많았지만 그래도 끝까지 잘 마쳐서 다행이다ㅠ 벌써 3번째 투어인데 이제 정말 투어전문가가 된것같아 어디가서 자랑해도 될것같아 ㅎㅎ 북미에서 본 웨이브들 모두 우리에게 좋은 힘을 줘서 너무 고맙다고 말하고싶고 또한번 사랑을 느끼게 해줘서 감사해요 끝까지 신나게 마치고 한국으로 돌아갈게 🫶🫶
messages.en: With Vancouver as our final stop, our North American tour performances are already coming to an end. Before we came, I was really worried about how the 24 of us would be able to tour together, but I'm relieved that everything went more smoothly than I had feared. There were many members who got sick or injured, but I'm still glad we managed to finish it all the way to the end.ㅠ This is already our third tour, and I think we've really become tour experts now. I feel like we could proudly brag about it anywhere.ㅎㅎ I want to say thank you so much to all the WAVs we met in North America for giving us such positive energy. Thank you for making us feel loved once again. We'll finish things off with lots of excitement and return to Korea! 🫶🫶
Seriously, you blink and it's already over, right?
We prepared a lot of things even for North America.
I can't tell you about them, though~
Please look forward to them when we get back to Korea, too.
WAV, I'm always grateful to you and I love you.
I feel a kind of love that I can't put into words,
and I wish WAV could become me and experience that feeling for themselves.
I'll give you a song recommendation for today.
I'm listening to it right now.
It's got a nice vibe.
Have you become the adult you dreamed of being?
By Meomureu.
It's an AI song, right?

messages.ko: 그래서 머무르님 다른 노래들 다 들어보면
messages.en: So if you listen to all of Meomureu's other songs,
the keywords and melodies are similar.

messages.ko: 나중엔 무대에도 ai하연이 춤추는거 아닌가 몰라
messages.en: I wonder if one day an AI Hayeon will be dancing on stage instead of me.
I really like Hayeon...
You can really only like Hayeon,
because Hayeon is the only one who can truly like Y/n.
What if it turns out I'm an AI too??
Then...

messages.ko: Y/n가 내가 좋아한 첫번째 ai가 되겠지
messages.en: Y/n would become the first AI I've ever liked.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋ
So when are you going to give us the NXT group photo?
Oh, right!
Joobin scolded me earlier.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
So, Joobin hurt her foot too,
and during 'Replay',
she was sitting on one side,
and I really shouldn't have laughed,
Agh ㅠㅠㅠㅠ
It was like we'd invited two backup singers,
with them both singing so enthusiastically from either side.
It's what gets me laughing every time.
No, it's not funny.
Oh, and also,
singing 'Lit Pop' for the first time in a while
reminded me of how hard I worked on the high-note parts during R.P.

messages.ko: 릿팝에서만 느낄수 있는 다현짱이 느낄 짜릿함
messages.en: That thrill Dahyun-chan gets to experience only in 'Lit Pop'...
When the cheers come right at my part,
it's such a thrill.

messages.ko: 일단 한국 가면 젤 먼저 하고싶은거
messages.en: The first thing I want to do when I get back to Korea
is go get a massage.
I wonder how many knots I've got in my body.
I can barely move.
I learned how to give massages too, you know.
As a side job.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
I'll get rid of your upper-arm fat for you.
I can only do arms, though.
That's the only part I learned.
Have you tried giving your mom a massage?
Of course I have.
When I went to my parents' house,
I gave her pretty much a full-body massage.
I'm a total professional.

messages.ko: 그리고 엄마가 레이어드 컷 하고싶다고 하길래
messages.en: And my mom said she wanted a layered haircut,
so I told her I'd try doing it for her,
and gave it a go.
My mom was extremely satisfied.
I cut it really well.
I'm overflowing with talent, right?
I do my mom's makeup sometimes, too.

messages.ko: 몇번 해보니까 엄마가 중요한날에도 해달라하고 그랬었는데
messages.en: After I'd done it a few times, she started asking me to do her makeup even for important occasions.
I'm amazing, right?
I even dressed my older brother up as a girl,
and when I did,
he was saying he thought he looked prettier than me,
and taking selfies.
Do you admit it?
Absolutely not.
I'd probably look more handsome dressed as a guy than my brother does.
ㅋ
Sorry about that ㅋ

messages.ko: 아니 근데 진짜 오빠분도 잘생기셨을거같다 둘이 닮았으면
messages.en: No, but seriously, your older brother must be handsome too if you two look alike.
I told you we don't look alike!
Don't make me mad.
I'm kidding.
My brother has his own charms~
Wow, once December comes,
it'll be the end of the year already???
Hayeon at 21???
Have I become an adult~
I was talking about this with Kim Chaewon earlier,
and both of us were like,
Why are we 21 when we're still such babies?
So, Hayeon, have you become the adult you dreamed of being?
I think I've become one to some extent.
Be a baby who dreams.
I should do that.

messages.ko: 꿈은 누구나 어떻게든 꿀 수 있으니까
messages.en: Because anyone can dream, one way or another.
I'll spend my whole life dreaming of who I can become,
and making those dreams come true!!
You're my dream.
Are you Park Yeon-jin..?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
I've been chatting with you without even drying my hair.
I have an early start tomorrow,
so I'll go to sleep soon.
Haranghae😘😘🫶🫶
